div.head: Cn 1018 36
div.ab: 7 þæt hi oðrum mannum unriht ne beodan ealles to swiðe. ac manna gehwilc oðrum béode. þæt riht sy. þæt he wille þæt man him beode. be þam þe hit mæð sy.
And þæt hi oðrum mannum unriht ne beodan ealles to swiðe, ac manna gehwilc oðrum beode þæt riht sy, þæt he wille þæt man him beode, be þam þe hit mæð sy.
And that they do not commit injustice against other men all too much, but each man should do what is right to others, what he wishes to be done to him, as far as he is able.
And that they are not to offer injustice to others all too greatly, but that to the best of their ability, everyone is to show that justice to others that they desire to be shown to themselves.
